findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.citation_text:
4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. 

A tea pot style container in the back room for Starbucks is observed with remaining food debris while in storage.  This indicates that it was not completely cleaned prior to storage. The PIC was shown and moved the item to the three part sink for soaking and re-cleaning. Ensure that all food contact surfaces are completely cleaned prior to storage in the facility.

findings.title: Utensils, equipment, and linens: properly stored, dried, and handled.
findings.citation_text:
4-903.11(A) Equipment, Utensils, Linens, and Single-Service and Single-Use Articles. (A) Except as specified in (D) of this section, cleaned EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS, laundered LINENS, and SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES shall be stored: (1) In a clean, dry location; (2) Where they are not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination; and (3) At least 15 cm (6 inches) above the floor.

A tub containing whipped canister lids and other food contact items is observed with brown debris in the bottom of the container in the Starbucks back-stock area. The PIC was shown and had the container, and items inside, cleaned during this inspection to correct. Ensure that all food contact items are protected from contamination while in storage and prior to use.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.citation_text:
6-501.12 Cleaning, Frequency and Restrictions. (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean.

Debris is observed under the counters along the back wall of the prep area for Starbucks. The PIC was notified and instructed to have the area cleaned often enough so as to prevent accumulation. Ensure the facility is cleaned often enough so as to remain clean at all times.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.citation_text:
6-201.11 Floors, Walls, and Ceilings. Except as specified under § 6-201.14 and except for antislip floor coverings or applications that may be used for safety reasons, floors, floor coverings, walls, wall coverings, and ceilings shall be designed, constructed, and installed so they are SMOOTH and EASILY CLEANABLE. 

The wall to the left of the ice bin in the Starbucks prep area is observed with crevices that prevent effective cleaning. The PIC was shown and instructed to seal prior to the next routine inspection. Ensure that all areas near moisture/food are sealed to allow for a smooth and easily cleanable surfaces.

findings.title: Adequate ventilation and lighting; designated areas used.
findings.citation_text:
6-403.11(A) Designated Areas. (A) Areas designated for EMPLOYEES to eat, drink, and use TOBACCO PRODUCTS shall be located so that FOOD, EQUIPMENT, LINENS, and SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES are protected from contamination.

Numerous consumed and partially consumed drinks are found on one set of shelves in the online order walk-in cooler where customer foods are stored. The PIC was shown and discarded the items during this inspection to correct the immediate violation. He also pointed out the shelving unit at the other end of the room designated for this purpose. They are instructed to review the storage of employee foods with employees to prevent this situation in the future.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
5-205.11: (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. 


On arrival the hand sinks in the Starbucks storage area and the ambient room are blocked. The PIC was consulted and moved the obstructions to correct the violations. Ensure that the hand sinks are maintained easily accessible at all times.

findings.title: Single-use/single-service articles: properly stored and used
findings.comment:
4-903.11: (C) SINGLE-USE ARTICLES shall be kept in original PACKAGE or stored in manner to protect it against contamination. 

Wooden stir sticks at the Starbucks counter are stored in a plastic container that needs cleaning. This was discussed with the PIC. The stirrers were discarded and the container cleaned to correct. Ensure that any food contact items are protected from contamination prior to use.

findings.title: Plumbing installed; proper backflow devices
findings.comment:
5-205.15: A PLUMBING SYSTEM shall be: (B) Maintained in good repair. 

The hand sink in the ambient room is observed to be leaking. The fixture also appears to be loose in its bracket. The PIC was shown/consulted and instructed to repair the fixture prior to the follow up. The normal follow up timeframe lands on a weekend, due to this the follow up will be conducted on Monday.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean.

Multiple locations in the facility are observed soiled during this inspection: 1) the floor around the pipes under the right side of the counter in the Starbucks area; 2) the wall behind where cases of water are stored; 3) the fan covers in the walk-in and; 4) the trash can shelving in the Starbucks area. All locations were shown to and discussed with the PIC and they are instructed to clean them. The facility should be swept, mopped and wiped often enough to be maintained in a clean state.
